subject: Request: Senior approval for Hosted API rate override (30% off) - Verdant Labs
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Senior approval for Hosted API rate override (30% off) - Verdant Labs

Team,

Quick summary: Verdant Labs is asking for a 30% off list Hosted API rate for a 12-month committed usage contract (minimum $450k ARR) in exchange for a 2x committed consumption ramp (Q4/Q1). They want redlines and a single-signature MLA and want to close by 7/24 for their fiscal planning.

Why I'm escalating: pricing > 20% is outside our standard deal desk authorization. Legal already reviewed the MLA and marked up a few limited changes (see attached Verdant_MLA_v1.2.pdf). Finance provided a forecasting file based on Verdant's telemetry (attached usage_forecast_verdant_q4q1.csv).

Key asks:
- Approval for a one-time rate override of 30% off hosted API list for the first 12 months (after that revert to standard volumes/tiers).
- Confirm we can offer a capped overage protection clause and a three-business-day DocuSign turnaround.

Customer rationale (from discovery):
- Core product going into pilot next month; they foresee heavy inference (embedding + chat) for a medical data product.
- Committed minimum spend but front-loaded token consumption in first 90 days.

Attachments: Verdant_MLA_v1.2.pdf (MLA draft), usage_forecast_verdant_q4q1.csv (forecast).

Proposed rollback controls: 6-week usage review, automatic throttle thresholds, and monthly chargeback reporting to their procurement team.

Impact if denied: deal likely pushed into next quarter; competitor X has already bid a 25% concession (not yet signed).

Recommendation: Approve the 30% concession with Finance controls and a one-time executive signoff to meet their close timeline.

Thanks,
Jonas
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Verdant_MLA_v1.2.pdf; usage_forecast_verdant_q4q1.csv
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Senior approval for Hosted API rate override (30% off) - Verdant Labs

Jonas — thanks for the context and the attachments. Quick notes from finance: 
- The modeled ARPU at 30% off with their committed minimum ($450k) still produces an acceptable blended margin given expected utilization and the proposed throttles.
- We insist on: 1) minimum contract value guarantee (MVG) of $450k; 2) monthly usage reporting and 14-day rights to audit; 3) automatic revert to standard pricing after 12 months.

Risks: front-loaded tokens in Q1 could spike operational egress/costs; recommend adding a short-term pre-funded token buffer or an overage guardband to protect against runaway cost.

If leadership wants to approve, finance will condition approval on: MVG in SOW and an explicit throttle/alert schedule to trigger manual review.

Mina
VP, Finance — Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Jul 2028 12:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Senior approval for Hosted API rate override (30% off) - Verdant Labs

Appreciate the layout Jonas. A couple of commercial notes:
- Verdant is strategic in medtech; a reference and later expansion into dedicated capacity are plausible.
- Competitor X's 25% number is real but lacks the SLA/observability we provide.

Ask for leadership: if we approve a 30% off, I propose we add a 10% performance credit tied to monthly latency SLOs (to protect our economics if their load pattern stresses p99 latency). That credit would be clawed back if thresholds are met.

Also propose a short clause: Redwood maintains right to throttle to standard per-token pricing beyond 150% of forecasted monthly token consumption without prior written approval.

If Ben/Laura are ok with these guardrails, I'm supportive.

Karthik
Head of Sales — Hosted API
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Jul 2028 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Senior approval for Hosted API rate override (30% off) - Verdant Labs

Team — after reviewing the forecast and the risk mitigations suggested by Mina and Karthik, I'll approve a one-time 30% hosted-API discount for Verdant Labs with the following binding conditions: 
1) $450k MVG in SOW (first 12 months).
2) Automatic revert to standard pricing at month 13.
3) Monthly usage reports and 14-day audit right.
4) Performance credit clause: up to 10% credit if p99 latency > 800ms for more than 2 production days in a month (credit mechanics in SOW).
5) Right to throttle/pricing revert if monthly consumption exceeds 150% of forecast without prior written consent.

Legal to finalize MLA with the above and send DocuSign. Jonas, you have executive signoff; proceed to commit and request customer signature.

Ben
Chief Revenue Officer, Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha.patel@verdantlabs.com>, contracts@verdantlabs.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Jul 2028 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API commercial - final MLA (30% off) — next steps and DocuSign

Asha — great to move quickly here; thanks for the productive call earlier.

Per our internal approvals, Redwood will offer a 30% off Hosted API rate on the attached MLA for a 12-month term with the following customer-facing highlights: 
- Minimum Value Guarantee (MVG): $450,000 for months 1–12.
- Pricing reversion: standard list pricing resumes month 13.
- Monthly usage reporting; customer grants Redwood 14-day audit rights for usage verification.
- Performance credit: up to 10% credit if p99 latency > 800ms for >2 production days/month (detailed in SOW).
- Throttle/revert clause: Redwood reserves right to revert to standard pricing if monthly consumption exceeds 150% of forecast without prior consent.

Next steps:
1) Please review the attached MLA (Verdant_MLA_v1.2.pdf) and the usage forecast.
2) Legal has prepared a DocuSign link for signature (embedded link below).
3) If the MLA looks good, sign via DocuSign by 7/24 to secure the special rate.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/embedded-sign/ABC-VERDANT-2143
Attachments: Verdant_MLA_v1.2.pdf, usage_forecast_verdant_q4q1.csv

Happy to hop on a 15-min call to walk through any redlines.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0147
From: Asha Patel <asha.patel@verdantlabs.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@verdantlabs.com, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API commercial - final MLA (30% off) — next steps and DocuSign

Jonas — thanks, appreciate the fast turnaround. I reviewed the changes and the DocuSign link works. We'll sign by Friday (7/24). One quick ask: can you confirm the SLA credit mechanics exactly match what's in the SOW before we sign? Our procurement team will want the final paragraph spelled out.

If you can send the single-page SLO summary I'll get our legal to greenlight.

Best,
Asha Patel
Head of Platform — Verdant Labs
